start.title: The First Breath
start.text:
You open your eyes in a warm garden.
A voice within whispers: you are loved.

choices.text: Work the garden and keep it
choices.feedback: Genesis 2:15 — The Lord God placed Adam in the garden of Eden to work it and keep it.

choices.text: Build a city of stone
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam building a city in Eden.

choices.text: Leave the garden to explore
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam leaving Eden on his own.

naming.title: Naming the Creatures
naming.text:
Animals gather, waiting.
The Lord asks you to name each one.

choices.text: Give each animal and bird a name
choices.feedback: Genesis 2:19-20 — Adam gave names to every living creature the Lord brought to him.

choices.text: Hunt the animals for food
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam hunting the animals in Eden.

lonely.title: Alone Among Pairs
lonely.text:
Every creature has its match.
Only you stand alone.

choices.text: Search among the animals and find no suitable helper
choices.feedback: Genesis 2:20 — For Adam no suitable helper was found among the animals.

choices.text: Take a lion as your companion
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam taking an animal as his companion.

choices.text: Shape a helper from the dust yourself
choices.feedback: Genesis says God, not Adam, made the woman.

deep_sleep.title: A Deep Sleep
deep_sleep.text:
A great peace covers you.
Your eyes close, and the Lord works.

choices.text: Fall into the deep sleep the Lord sends
choices.feedback: Genesis 2:21 — The Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam and took one of his ribs.

choices.text: Fight to stay awake
choices.feedback: Genesis says a deep sleep fell on Adam; he did not resist.

meet_eve.title: Bone of My Bone
meet_eve.text:
You wake — and she is there.
A woman, made for you, equal to you.

choices.text: Say: 'This is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh'
choices.feedback: Genesis 2:23 — Adam said, 'This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh.'

choices.text: Send her away
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam refusing the woman.

choices.text: Call her a beast of the field
choices.feedback: Genesis says Adam called her Woman, not a beast.

warning.title: The Forbidden Tree
warning.text:
God shows you one tree set apart.
"Do not eat from this one, or you will die."

choices.text: Receive the command not to eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil
choices.feedback: Genesis 2:16-17 — God commanded Adam not to eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

choices.text: Cut down the tree
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam cutting down the tree.

choices.text: Eat from the tree right away
choices.feedback: In Genesis 2, Adam did not eat from the tree at this moment.

serpent.title: The Serpent's Question
serpent.text:
A serpent speaks to Eve:
"Did God really say you must not eat?"

choices.text: Stay there with Eve while the serpent speaks
choices.feedback: Genesis 3:6 — Eve gave the fruit to her husband, who was with her.

choices.text: Strike the serpent with a stick
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam striking the serpent.

choices.text: Call out to the Lord for help
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam calling to the Lord at this moment.

fruit.title: The Fruit in Her Hand
fruit.text:
Eve has taken the fruit. She offers it to you.
Her eyes plead — and burn.

choices.text: Take the fruit and eat
choices.feedback: Genesis 3:6 — Adam took the fruit Eve gave him and ate it.

choices.text: Throw the fruit away
choices.feedback: Genesis says Adam ate the fruit; he did not throw it away.

choices.text: Offer the fruit back to God
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam offering the fruit to God.

shame.title: Eyes Opened
shame.text:
You see yourselves — bare, afraid.
Fig leaves cannot cover what has changed.

choices.text: Sew fig leaves together and hide among the trees
choices.feedback: Genesis 3:7-8 — They sewed fig leaves together and hid themselves among the trees of the garden.

choices.text: Step out and approach God openly
choices.feedback: Genesis says Adam and Eve hid; they did not come out to meet God.

choices.text: Eat from the tree of life
choices.feedback: Genesis does not describe Adam eating from the tree of life at this moment.

confrontation.title: "Where Are You?"
confrontation.text:
The Lord walks in the garden and calls.
His voice is not angry — it is grieved.

choices.text: Answer: 'The woman You gave me — she gave me the fruit, and I ate'
choices.feedback: Genesis 3:12 — Adam said, 'The woman you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate.'

choices.text: Confess plainly: 'I have sinned against You'
choices.feedback: Genesis says Adam blamed the woman rather than confessing plainly.

choices.text: Stay silent
choices.feedback: Genesis says Adam answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

expulsion.title: East of Eden
expulsion.text:
He clothes you both, then opens the gate.
You take her hand. You walk east, into the world.
